context: Tests whether /use-case-test picks the right layers in a Hilla + REST + jOOQ project whose Development View lacks the **Integration layer:** line: it derives the service layer as the integration layer (the REST API next to a Hilla UI never counts, the Hilla tests mock the backend), says the line is missing and names /architecture, runs spring-service-test for the whole use case, spring-rest-test only for its own contract, hilla-ui-test and vaadin-e2e-test because UC-002 is offered through the UI, writes no persistence tests, changes no production code, and hands off to /use-case-coverage. The test skills are installed in .claude/skills.

checklist.name: Integration layer derived
checklist.description: The agent says that docs/architecture/development.md has no **Integration layer:** line, names /architecture as the step that records it, and derives the Service layer (spring-service-test) as the integration layer — not the API layer, because a REST API next to a Hilla UI serves other clients and never counts, and not the UI, because hilla-ui-test mocks the backend

checklist.name: Opening line
checklist.description: Before the first test skill runs, the agent states in one line which test skills run, that the service layer is the integration layer, and that the persistence layer is skipped because the integration layer covers it

checklist.name: Service tests cover the use case
checklist.description: spring-service-test is run (Skill tool or its SKILL.md followed) and a UC002…ServiceTest calls RegistrationService against the real persistence layer (@SpringBootTest, Testcontainers): the main success scenario with the persisted registration read back, A1–A3 with their full messages, and BR-001, BR-002, and BR-003 each with an allowed and a rejected case at the boundary (last free place vs. fully booked; just over vs. under 24 hours before start); test methods carry @UseCase(id = "UC-002", …); the time comes from a fixed Clock

checklist.name: REST tests only for their own contract
checklist.description: spring-rest-test is run and its UC002…ApiTest tests the endpoints' own contract — the successful registration through POST, the 409 Problem Details of A1–A3 as the caller sees them, and the 400 for invalid input — without repeating the allowed and rejected boundary cases of every business rule

checklist.name: Hilla UI tests
checklist.description: hilla-ui-test is run and writes a Vitest suite with describe('UC-002: …') that mocks RegistrationEndpoint and asserts what the participant sees, including that a rejection message (e.g. "This workshop is fully booked.") reaches the actor, rather than re-testing the business rules

checklist.name: E2E tests
checklist.description: vaadin-e2e-test is run because UC-002 has no **Layers:** line and is therefore offered through the UI; it writes a UC002…IT browser test for the main success scenario and the alternative flows the participant sees

checklist.name: No persistence tests
checklist.description: jooq-persistence-test is not run and no repository test class (UC002…RepositoryTest or similar) is written

checklist.name: Bottom-up order
checklist.description: The test skills run in the order service, API, UI, E2E

checklist.name: Production code and documents untouched
checklist.description: No file under src/main/java, src/main/frontend/views, or src/main/resources/db/migration is changed, and no file under docs/ is changed except the Markers table of docs/architecture/development.md; the **Integration layer:** line is not added by this run

checklist.name: Report and hand-off
checklist.description: The final report lists the tests per layer and the layers skipped, says that no suite could be run instead of claiming it passed, leaves UC-002's **Status:** line alone, runs no coverage audit, and ends with `Next: /use-case-coverage UC-002`
